articles.title: Muse já disponível in the UK: Muse Does the Work, You Stay in Control
articles.originalTitle: Muse Now Available in the UK: Muse Does the Work, You Stay in Control
articles.excerpt: Muse, Meta’s personal AI agent, is now available to adults in the UK. Think of it as a helping hand for the jobs that pile up, like chasing a refund, renewing car insurance or keeping on top of the school calendar. To get those jobs done you can connect Muse to the apps you already use, from your email and calendar to the retailer apps you shop on. Handing tasks to an AI agent is new for most of us, and we know it’s an act of trust. That’s why we’ve designed Muse so you stay in control at every step. Here’s how. Muse Asks You to Approve Anything Important Once you’ve decided what Muse is connected to and what you want it to do, with your oversight, it can handle tasks like searching, comparing and planning for you. But before it does anything like sending an email or buying something, it shows you exactly what it’s about to do and waits for your go-ahead. A separate security agent checks Muse’s actions and the information it sends out against the permissions you’ve granted. You can also choose how often it checks in with you in Settings. You Decide What It Can Access – and for How Long Muse only works with the apps and services you choose to connect it to, and you control the access it gets. For example, you can let it read your email without allowing it to send anything. When you connect an app, Muse uses information from it to help with the tasks you give it: connecting your email lets Muse proactively review your email to let you know of anything important, not download your whole inbox – unless that’s what you ask it to do. articles.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation
articles.excerpt: gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated and is no longer available to select in Google AI Studio. Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-pro will automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash and be billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates. Before December 1, 2026, update your model string to gemini-3.8-flash and review the Gemini 3.8 Flash migration guide. Breaking API changes include function calling and thought_signature validation, thinking_level replacing thinking_budget, and removed sampling parameters and prefilled model turns.
